tools.name: photonhealth_list_patients
tools.description: List the organization's patients (id, external id, name, date of birth, sex, contact, address), optionally filtered by name. Photon GraphQL: patients.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_patient
tools.description: Get one patient by Photon id, with allergies, medication history, preferred pharmacies, and their prescriptions and orders (ids + states). Photon GraphQL: patient.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_prescriptions
tools.description: List the organization's prescriptions, filterable by patient, prescriber and state (ACTIVE, EXPIRED, DEPLETED, CANCELED). Each has the medication, quantity, refills/fills remaining, directions, diagnoses and fills. Photon GraphQL: prescriptions.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_prescription
tools.description: Get one prescription by id: state, prescriber, patient, medication (with RxCUI/NDC codes), quantity, refills and fills remaining, days supply, directions, notes, diagnoses, dates and fills. Photon GraphQL: prescription.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_orders
tools.description: List pharmacy orders, filterable by patient and state (ROUTING, PENDING, PLACED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, ERROR). Each has the pharmacy, delivery address, fulfillment (type, state, carrier, tracking number) and fills. Photon GraphQL: orders.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: state, patient, pharmacy, address, fulfillment status/tracking and its fills. Photon GraphQL: order.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_fill
tools.description: Get one fill (a single dispensing of a prescription within an order) by id: state (SCHEDULED, NEW, SENT, CANCELED), requested/filled times, medication, prescription and order. Photon GraphQL: fill.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_pharmacies
tools.description: Search pharmacies by name and/or near a location (latitude/longitude + radius in miles), by fulfillment type (PICK_UP = retail, MAIL_ORDER). Returns NPI, NCPDP, address, phone, fax. Photon GraphQL: pharmacies.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_pharmacy
tools.description: Get one pharmacy by Photon id: name, NPI, NCPDP, address, phone, fax and fulfillment types. Photon GraphQL: pharmacy.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_medications
tools.description: Search Photon's medication database by drug name (partial) or code (RxCUI, NDC or SKU). Returns DRUG-level concepts with RxCUI/NDC codes, schedule, controlled flag, strength and form; drill down with list_medication_products / list_medication_packages. Photon GraphQL: medications.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_medication_products
tools.description: List the prescribable products (strength + form) of a DRUG-level medication from search_medications. Photon GraphQL: medicationProducts.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_medication_packages
tools.description: List the packages (package NDCs) of a PRODUCT-level medication from list_medication_products. Photon GraphQL: medicationPackages.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_medication_by_ndc
tools.description: Find the medication matching a package NDC (11-digit National Drug Code). Photon GraphQL (clinical API): medicationFromNdc.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_medical_equipment
tools.description: Search prescribable medical equipment/supplies (e.g. glucose test strips) by name. Photon GraphQL: medicalEquipment.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_catalogs
tools.description: List the organization's treatment catalogs (the medications it prescribes) with their treatments and prescription templates. Photon GraphQL: catalogs.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_catalog
tools.description: Get one treatment catalog by id with its treatments and prescription templates (quantity, refills, days supply, directions). Photon GraphQL: catalog.

tools.name: photonhealth_search_allergens
tools.description: Search Photon's allergen list by name (fuzzy), e.g. to map a patient's reported allergy to an allergen id/RxCUI. Photon GraphQL: allergens.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_dispense_units
tools.description: List the dispense units Photon accepts on a prescription (e.g. Each, Milliliter, Tablet). Photon GraphQL: dispenseUnits.

tools.name: photonhealth_get_organization
tools.description: Get the Photon organization these API keys belong to: id, name, type, NPI, address and contact details. Photon GraphQL (clinical API): organization.

tools.name: photonhealth_list_users
tools.description: List the organization's users (prescribers and staff): id, name, email, NPI, credentials and roles — use an id as prescriber_id in list_prescriptions. Photon GraphQL (clinical API): users.

tools.name: photonhealth_screen_interactions
tools.description: Screen proposed medications for a patient against drug-drug and drug-allergy (and diagnosis) interactions, using the patient's allergies, medication history and existing prescriptions. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "photonhealth_search_medications" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "photonhealth_list_users" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: photonhealth_list_users · Private data: photonhealth_list_patients, photonhealth_search_medications, photonhealth_get_organization, photonhealth_list_users · Public sink: photonhealth_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: photonhealth_list_users · Private data: photonhealth_list_patients, photonhealth_search_medications, photonhealth_get_organization, photonhealth_list_users · Public sink: photonhealth_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
